tex_content.html:
Corollary
[The Curvature Tensor in Dimension 3] ↗ cor:curvature-space-dimensions ↗ prop:weyl-decomposition 1. ch7:7.26

On every Riemannian or pseudo-Riemannian $3$-manifold, $W=0$ and \begin{equation} \mathrm{Rm}=P\owedge g =\mathrm{Rc}\owedge g-\frac14S\, g\owedge g. \tag {7.39} \end{equation} Thus the Ricci tensor determines the full curvature tensor.

Proof

\sketch In dimension three, $G$ and $\operatorname {tr}_g$ are inverse isomorphisms. Since $\operatorname {tr}_gW=0$, one has $W=0$; the displayed formula follows from the definition of $P$.

□
